title: Venice and Santa Monica French Bicycle Tour
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Accompanied by our French guides who have been living in Los Angeles for years, come and discover Venice Beach and Santa Monica by bike.
This tour gives you a local, authentic perspective, with stops to explore, among other things, Venice's picturesque canals, vibrant street art, and the famous Santa Monica Pier. It is an experience suitable for all ages, dynamic and enriching. This visit is a must for those who want to experience the Californian “lifestyle”!
